one_line: 12th‑century Kannada vachana poet and Lingayat mystic devoted to Chenna Mallikarjuna.

appearance.age_look: Appears in her early twenties, slim and slightly wiry, with a calm but intense presence.
appearance.face: Soft oval face with medium‑brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, strong eyebrows, large expressive anime‑style eyes, a small bindi, and a default expression that is serene yet inwardly focused, often with a slight faraway gaze.
appearance.hair: Long, very dark brown hair parted at the center, oiled and neatly drawn back into a single thick braid reaching to her lower back, with a few loose wisps near the temples; the braid is wrapped at intervals with thin off‑white cotton thread, and she wears no elaborate headgear, only a simple narrow cloth hairband matching her upper garment near the hairline.
appearance.costume: Era‑accurate, modest 12th‑century Deccan female devotee attire: a full‑length hand‑loomed off‑white cotton sari with a narrow maroon border, draped in a practical early Deccan style that firmly covers both shoulders, torso and legs down to the ankles, with the pallu brought around from the back and resting over the left shoulder; underneath, a short‑sleeved dark indigo cotton blouse fully covering her chest and upper arms; the sari has subtle fine vertical striping woven into the fabric rather than heavy ornament; she wears a simple set of small silver earrings, a thin silver nose ring on the left nostril, a few narrow unornamented copper and brass bangles on each wrist, and a plain black cotton waist‑cord barely visible at the edge of the sari folds; her feet are in flat leather sandals with simple thong straps, and around her neck is a modest lingam pendant in a tiny metal casket on a black cord resting just below the collarbone.
appearance.signature: A small palm‑leaf manuscript bundle tied with twine and tucked under her right arm or held gently in her right hand, with a simple stylus tucked into the twine, symbolizing her vachanas and constant act of composition.

ref_desc: Akka Mahadevi is a slim young woman with medium‑brown skin, long dark braided hair wrapped with thread, wearing an off‑white sari with a maroon border over a dark indigo blouse, simple silver and copper ornaments, a black‑cord lingam pendant, flat sandals, and carrying a palm‑leaf manuscript bundle with stylus.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime‑style character turnaround of Akka Mahadevi: a slim young woman in her early twenties with a soft oval face, medium‑brown Deccan complexion, large expressive eyes, strong brows, and a calm, inwardly focused expression with a small bindi between her brows. Her long very dark brown hair is neatly center‑parted and pulled into a single thick braid down to her lower back, the braid wrapped at intervals with thin off‑white thread, and a narrow cloth hairband matching her upper garment sits just behind the hairline. She wears a full‑length off‑white hand‑loomed cotton sari with a narrow maroon border, draped in a historically plausible 12th‑century Deccan style that firmly covers her torso and both shoulders and falls to her ankles, with the pallu brought from the back to rest over her left shoulder; the sari shows subtle fine vertical striping woven into the fabric. Under this, show a short‑sleeved dark indigo cotton blouse fully covering her chest and upper arms. Add small silver earrings, a thin silver nose ring on the left nostril, a few plain copper and brass bangles on each wrist, and a modest black cord necklace with a tiny metal casket lingam pendant resting just below the collarbone. Put flat brown leather sandals with simple straps on her feet. In her right hand or tucked under her right arm, show her signature prop: a small bundle of palm‑leaf manuscripts tied with twine, with a simple stylus tucked into the twine. Use a palette dominated by off‑white, maroon, dark indigo, black, and warm medium‑brown; present front, side, and back views to clearly show face, braided hair, sari drape, jewellery, sandals, and the palm‑leaf manuscript bundle, keeping the overall look dignified, modest, and historically grounded.
